Ferrous parts whose rusting might cause non-compliance shall be adequately protected. Test (addition): degrease 10 min in carbon tetrachloride/trichloroethane; immerse 10 min in 10 percent ammonium chloride solution at 15–35 °C; without drying (drops shaken off) place 10 min in air ≥ 90 percent RH at 15–35 °C; dry 10 min at 100 ± 5 °C — surfaces shall show no signs of rust (traces on sharp edges and yellowish rub-off film ignored). Grease layer may protect small springs/abraded parts (tested with grease if effectiveness in doubt); ferrous parts forming part of the heating element wire exempt
